findings.finding: Set a+A=2(b+B) and a+A=b+B+10 → b+B=10, a+A=20. Write A=20−a, B=10−b. Use aA=4bB → a(20−a)=4b(10−b) and a(A−5)=b(B+5) → a(15−a)=b(15−b). Search a∈[1,15], b∈[1,10]; only (a,b)=(10,5) works. Ages product=10·5=50.
Key: From sum conditions get a+A=20, b+B=10. Set A=20‑a, B=10‑b. Solve a(20‑a)=4b(10‑b) and a(15‑a)=b(15‑b) with a≤15, A≥5. Unique solution a=10,b=5. Product=50.
